prompt:
Create TWO circular painted avatar BACKGROUNDS for a hand-painted fantasy mobile RPG, side by side, each a perfect circle about 420 px wide, on a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with wide magenta gutters.

Reference 1 is an approved avatar of the same hero: copy its painting style, soft lighting, colour richness and level of detail for the BACKGROUND only.
Left circle (form 2): violet storm clouds lit by thin lightning and small stars.
Right circle (form 3): a deep cosmic nebula in purple and gold with bright stars.

NO character, NO person, NO face, NO creature, NO text, NO frame or border ring: only the painted scenery filling each circle edge to edge, a little brighter and calmer in the middle and lower half where a portrait will be placed on top. Each circle clearly different from the other and from the reference's background. Crisp circle edges, nothing outside the circles, no magenta or pink inside the art.

precheck.summary: Two circular scenery panels sit side by side on a flat magenta background, as the prompt asks. The left shows violet storm clouds with lightning and the right shows a purple and gold nebula with stars. There are no characters, text, or frame rings, and no visible magenta inside the circles.
